active_continuity: Dark Heaven has begun a three-hundred-man assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan under the First Fiend's leadership.
The First Fiend is one of the Qilian Three Fiends; the Second and Third Fiends have gone to Qingcheng and Emei.
The Dark Heaven flag has been raised over the assault, and the attackers act under the Lord of Heaven's command.
The Sichuan Tang Clan is surrounded and fighting back from its walls.
The Uninvited Guest Quest is automatically accepted with unknown parameters and death as its failure condition.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious with unstable qi after treatment.
Taekyung is remaining with Jeok while Cheongpung goes to aid the Tang Clan and return.
open_questions: What are the limits and nature of the Western Heaven Demon Lord's demonic martial art?
How large is Dark Heaven's force beyond the three hundred attackers identified here?
Can the Sichuan Tang Clan survive the assault?
Will Jeok Cheongang recover before the siege exposes him to external shock?
temporary_decisions: Render 일괴, 이괴, and 삼괴 as First Fiend, Second Fiend, and Third Fiend.
Render 악귀 as Fiend when used as the First Fiend's descriptive epithet.
Render 초대받지 않은 손님 as Uninvited Guest.
Render 마군 as Demon Lord when used as the Western Heaven Demon Lord's shortened title.
